svg.title: Planned implant geometry and recorded Neuropixels trajectories
svg.desc: A shows planned probe trajectories; B enlarges the six atlas-structure columns over the full figure height; C shows the implant top view. D shows one complete oblique view of the recorded trajectories, with rostral-left orientation selected to match the planned view in A. The source coordinate table is transcribed in Methods rather than repeated here.

g.title: All localized Neuropixels insertions in the Allen CCF
g.desc: A planned-orientation oblique projection shows all localized Neuropixels insertions over semi-transparent, depth-shaded projections of the Allen CCF whole-brain surface. Line color denotes probe A through F; each panel includes a 2 millimeter scale bar and anatomical direction marker.
